name: @wizeworks/field-schema
description: sparx field-schema — the neutral typed-field engine. Declares the 18 field kinds (text, long_text, rich_text, slug, number, boolean, date, datetime, enum, url, email, reference, asset, currency, user, calculated, object, repeater), the FieldSchema shape, the runtime body validator, and the eval-free calculated-field engine. Domain-agnostic: consumed by @wizeworks/cms-schemas (content types), @wizeworks/commerce-schemas (product types) and @wizeworks/crm-schemas (CRM object properties) so one field engine backs all three.
